text_block_list.text:
In her first three years of the Twinkle Series,
Biko Pegasus posted fairly decent results.

It caught the director's eye, greenlighting a movie!
I thought it would move all of America to tears, but...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I got a message
from big sis in America!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Biko-chan. Since then, I returned
here and started filming my second movie.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
"And then... sorry about the hero movie thing.
The director was just messing around."

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: "It's true that I was moved by Biko-chan's running, but jumping straight into making a movie is a bit much, you know."

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Though, it looks like they want to make a movie based on Biko-chan someday.
If they do, I definitely want to play the lead!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: That's right! The role of Justice Biko definitely belongs to big sis!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right, if I want a movie made about me,
I need to become an even greater hero!
Trainer, to make that happen...!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's give it our all in the race!
Yeah, let's do our best in the race!

text_block_list.text: If Biko Pegasus makes a big splash in her races, the chances will only go up.

"A movie adaptation is something I'll have to earn,
including what this big sister does from here on out."

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: "I know things must be tough for you too, Biko-chan, but honestly, it's tough on this side as well... The competition really is fierce, after all."

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
There are plenty of girls good at action, good at acting,
and full of charm. But...!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose!
After all, we've got the Carrot Spirit!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'm heading back to the shoot, see ya!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I see, big sisters have it tough too, huh...
I totally get it!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
We're in the middle of fierce daily battles too, ya know!
The rival army's commanders are all crazy strong~

"...It was just as they said.
While victory wasn't impossible,
I was simply born in the wrong era."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now, Biko, it's time for a rematch!
The brand-new Class Rep shall take you on!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Fufu, today I coordinated a slightly bittersweet race outfit. Sorry about that♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Your number one rival has gotta be me, right,
Biko-chan?☆

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Looking forward to it-MASU! I may still be
fresh, but I'll make a big BANG-BANG!
In addition to familiar, formidable rivals, the new generation's bullet train Umamusume, Taiki Shuttle, makes her entrance.
Even when giving it her all, she often finishes in 2nd place, but...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Looking down isn't gonna help anything!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: A hero always finds a wall standing in their way. Isn't that right?

Biko Pegasus doesn't hang her head.
Even if she can't easily break through to the front...

An unbreakable spirit worthy of a hero. This was
the undeniable proof of growth from our three years together.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right, to defeat my rivals and the monsters,
there's only one thing to do!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: That sounds nice too, but today...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Let's rewatch Carrotman together
from episode one!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Full of nutrients! Full of justice!
Carotene charge, Carrotman!!
My days with Biko Pegasus continued. Pouring ourselves into training every day, and then—
Every Sunday morning, they would sit side by side in front of the TV, cheering for their hero.
